title: The Organic Pharmacy reacquired by founder Margo Marrone
summary: Margo Marrone has reacquired The Organic Pharmacy a decade after selling it to Italian pharmaceutical group Istituto Ganassini, aiming to re-bolster the brand’s ‘founding philosophy of health, detoxification and lifestyle’
